name: Content
description: Content is your saved-content shelf: generations you saved from a studio or Library, files you uploaded, PDFs and stock media from Pexels. Its side-menu label is "Content" and its route is #/content-library.
shortDescription: Your saved content: saved generations, uploads, PDFs and stock media.
fullDescription: Content (route #/content-library, shown in the menu as "Content") is headed "Content" with the line "Your saved content — generations you saved, uploads, PDFs and stock media". Filter tabs are All, Saved, Images, Videos, Audio and PDFs. There is a search box ("Search saved content..."), a "Browse Stock Media" button (Pexels), and an upload button (upload picker, up to 10 images, videos accepted). A status line shows the count, for example "3 items in saved". Empty state: "Nothing saved yet - Use Save to Content on any result in a studio or in your Library, or upload files here." Saved generations are kept in your browser (local storage), so saving always works; uploads and stock-media entries go to the cloud content library when the deployment has it configured, otherwise they are kept in the browser too.
bestFor: Keeping and reusing the files you care about: favourites, reference uploads, PDFs and licensed stock clips/photos.
whenToUse: You want a short list of keepers apart from your full history.
You want to upload PDFs or videos to reuse.
You want free stock photos or videos from Pexels.
whenToUseAnother: For everything you have ever generated, use Library (#/library).
To generate new content, open a studio from Apps (#/apps).
keyFeatures: Tabs: All, Saved, Images, Videos, Audio, PDFs.
Search saved content by filename, prompt or model.
Browse Stock Media (Pexels) with automatic attribution.
Upload files (images, videos; PDFs are supported in the content library).

featureExplanations.explanation: In a studio result or in Library, press Save (the toast says "Saved to Content"). The item then appears here under Saved with its prompt and model.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Saved generations are stored in this browser, so they do not follow you to another browser or device.

featureExplanations.explanation: Opens a stock picker titled "Stock Media" for images and videos from Pexels. Choosing one saves it here with the photographer credit ("Name on Pexels") and a PEXELS badge.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Free stock for backgrounds and b-roll.
featureExplanations.restrictions: You can add your own Pexels key in Settings (optional); otherwise shared access is used. Keep the attribution when you publish.

featureExplanations.explanation: Use the upload button to add files; each is saved to Content. The cloud content library accepts PDFs and videos.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Cloud upload accepts only PDF and video files ("Only PDF and video files are allowed."). Without the cloud setup, entries stay local.

featureExplanations.explanation: Hover an item and press the red delete button. For saved items the prompt is "Remove this from Content? (It stays in your Library.)". For other files it asks to delete the file by name.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Deleting a saved item only removes it from Content.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click an item to see it large (image, video with controls, audio player or PDF viewer), its filename, attribution if any, size, and a Download button.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Close with the X or by clicking outside.

howToUse: 1. Open Content from the left side menu (My Work group). 2. To add items, press Save on a result in a studio or Library, press Browse Stock Media, or use the upload button. 3. Use the tabs All, Saved, Images, Videos, Audio or PDFs and the search box to find items. 4. Click an item to preview and Download. 5. Hover and use the delete button to remove it.
howToSteps: Open Content from the left side menu.
Add items by Save (from Library/studios), Browse Stock Media, or upload.
Filter with the tabs and search.
Click an item to preview or download.
Delete items you no longer need.
gettingStarted: Open Library, hover a result and press Save, then open Content > Saved.

inputDetails.restrictions: Cloud storage accepts PDFs and videos.

limitationDetails.limitation: Saved items do not sync across browsers
limitationDetails.impact: Saved items disappear if you clear site data or switch device.
limitationDetails.workaround: Download important files from the preview.

troubleshooting: Nothing saved yet: use Save in Library or a studio, or upload.
Failed to delete: a toast shows the error; retry.
Stock media will not load: check your connection; optionally add your Pexels key in Settings.
Upload rejected: "Only PDF and video files are allowed." for cloud upload.

steps: Check the Saved tab and search.
Check Library, where the original still lives.
If you cleared browser data, saved items kept locally are gone; save again from Library.

commonProblems.problem: Removed from Content but still in Library
commonProblems.whyItHappens: Content and Library are separate shelves; removing a saved item keeps the original in Library.
commonProblems.howToFix: Delete it from Library too if you want it gone.

Open Content and use the Saved tab.

faqs.question: What is Content?
faqs.answer: The shelf for what you chose to keep: saved generations, uploads, PDFs and Pexels stock media.

faqs.question: How is Content different from Library?
faqs.answer: Library holds everything you generate automatically. Content holds items you saved or added. Removing from Content keeps the item in Library.

faqs.question: How do I save something to Content?
faqs.answer: Press Save on a result in a studio or hover an item in Library and press Save.

faqs.question: Is stock media free to use?
faqs.answer: The code credits the photographer ("Name on Pexels") and shows a PEXELS badge. Pexels licence terms are not described in the app, so check Pexels before commercial use.

glossary.Saved: Items you saved from a studio or Library.
glossary.PEXELS: Badge for stock media from Pexels.
glossary.Attribution: The photographer credit stored with stock media.

tips: Use the Saved tab for a quick favourites view.
Keep attribution text when publishing Pexels media.
bestPractices: Download critical files; saved items are stored in this browser.
notConfirmed: Storage quotas and retention are not documented.
Pexels licence terms and commercial-use rules are not stated in the app.
Whether images can be uploaded to cloud Content (the cloud upload function itself accepts only PDF and video) is not fully clear from the code.
